raw_segments.text: That system which represents the produce of land as the sole source of the revenue and wealth of
every country, has so far as I know, never been adopted by any nation, and it at present exists
only in the speculations of a few men of great learning and ingenuity in France. It would not,
surely, be worth while to examine at great length the errors of a system which never has done,
and probably never will do, any harm in any part of the world.
I shall endeavor to explain, however, as distinctly as I can,
the great outlines of this very ingenious system.
